# Latenode

> > Latenode is a low-code automation platform supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations with AI models, business apps, and workflow automation tools.

Latenode enables users to build automated workflows connecting popular services like OpenAI, Hugging Face, Google Meet, Microsoft Excel, Shopify, Stripe, and hundreds of other applications. The platform emphasizes MCP server integrations and competes with automation tools like Zapier, Make, and n8n Cloud.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Workflow Automation
- MCP Integration
- AI Model Integration
- No-Code Automation
- Low-Code Platform
- OpenAI
- Hugging Face
- Claude
- Zapier Alternative
- Make Alternative

- App Integration
- AI Automation
- Document Processing
